study: Retrospective independent-system measured trajectory validation; not an intervention trial

prior_inspection: Array field names, sizes, ranges, first values and published figures/captions inspected before freezing. No fitting or holdout model scoring has occurred. Public holdout is not claimed prospectively unseen to humanity.

additional_training.role: 18 steady-state growth observations at6 light levels,3 biological replicate series; only Hill shape model calibration

models.shared_dynamics: z=logit(photophilic cell fraction); dz/dt=g; dg/dt=(g_inf(L)-g)/tau_sign; tau_up if g_inf>=g else tau_down; exact constant-input update
models.dose_informed: g_inf=g_dark+(g_bright-g_dark)*H(L)/H(800), H=L^n/(K^n+L^n). K,n fitted only to figure2 steady-state growth rates with independent offset/amplitude.
models.composition_loss: Equal trajectory total weight: residual_fraction/sqrt(number_of_post_initial_observations), soft_l1 f_scale0.03; deterministic8starts; lowest training objective retained. No holdout model selection.
models.dose_loss: ordinary least squares across18 observations;12starts K30/100/300/1000 x n0.5/1/2; lowest training objective

evaluation.primary: Each complete heldout trajectory: free-run fraction RMSE/MAE/terminal absolute error. Macro-average across8 trajectories, not pooled observations as replicates. All postinitial points included.
evaluation.one_step: Reinitialize z to measured fraction at time k, propagate g using training parameters and input history only, predict k+1. Not an observer or closed-loop controller simulation.
evaluation.baselines: Free-run constant initial fraction; one-step persistence of current measured fraction.
evaluation.inputs: Zero-order hold of recorded LightInput[k] over [t[k],t[k+1]); final input unused. Setpoint never a model input.
evaluation.diagnostics: Report <=40h and >40h separately because published SI describes drift after40h; primary remains full trajectory.
evaluation.sensitivity: Six leave-one-training-trajectory-out refits and three leave-one-dose-replicate-out refits. Report deterministic sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals. No holdout retuning.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report optimizer convergence, active bounds, Jacobian singular values/conditioning, multistart costs and all fit failures. No calibrated probability coverage or safety claim.
evaluation.alignment: Left-held input specified from publisher code control update at measured state. No optimization of input delay on holdout.

limits: Cell fraction is not yeast dry-weight ratio.
Optogenetic E.coli turbidostat in LB+chloramphenicol is not glucose-fed SC/KP fed-batch.
Recorded-input prediction is not off-policy validation of a new controller.
Long-run mutation/drift not present in fixed-parameter model; retain failure.
Six open-loop traces do not identify arbitrary intermediate input response; dose-informed model uses explicitly separate training measurements.
